tyre_grip_none: The simulator reports no change in tyre grip over {n} laps (wear is effectively off).
tyre_grip_minimal: The simulator does model tyre wear{rate}, but only {loss}% of grip was lost over {n} laps ({per_lap}% per lap): too little to move the lap time. A longer run or a higher wear rate would show it.
tyre_grip_measured: The simulator measured a real grip loss: {loss}% over {n} laps ({per_lap}% per lap){rate}. Lap times do not show it reliably (fuel burn, track evolution, traffic or mistakes hide it), so trust this figure.
tyre_incident_laps_excluded: Laps {laps} were left out of the pace trend because of a spin or an off-track.
